title: Prove Minkowski axiom using Mathlib measure theory

problemStatement.plain: Prove minkowski_fundamental axiom in MinkowskiFundamentalTheorem.lean from Mathlib's ZSpan and measure theory infrastructure.

currentState.focus: Proved ℤⁿ case from Mathlib GeometryOfNumbers; general lattice axiom remains
blockers: HasVolume abstraction barrier: disconnected from actual Lebesgue measure
Custom Lattice n → Module.Basis bridge requires ~100 lines of unverifiable Lean
currentState.nextAction: Build-verify with Docker, then bridge custom Lattice n to ZSpan for general case

knowledge.progressSummary: BLOCKED: Axiom requires type-bridge refactoring. HasVolume (abstract ℝ) must connect to MeasureTheory.volume (ENNReal). Custom Lattice n must map to Module.Basis. Mathematical content already proved in MinkowskiProved section. 3+ sessions on this gap — needs architectural refactoring, not incremental work.
builtItems: MinkowskiProved.stdBasis — standard basis for Fin n → ℝ
MinkowskiProved.stdLattice — ℤⁿ as ZSpan of standard basis
MinkowskiProved.minkowski_integer_lattice_proved — Minkowski for ℤⁿ from Mathlib (no axioms)
MinkowskiProved.minkowski_general_lattice_proved — general Minkowski for any basis (from Mathlib)
insights: Mathlib has exists_ne_zero_mem_lattice_of_measure_mul_two_pow_lt_measure — the core Minkowski theorem
The file uses custom Lattice n, ConvexBody n, HasVolume, criticalVolume, latticePoints structures that don't align with Mathlib's ZSpan API
ThreeSquares.lean already uses ZSpan.fundamentalDomain and ZSpan.isAddFundamentalDomain for Minkowski applications — can serve as reference
Bridge strategy: (1) map custom Lattice n → Mathlib ZSpan, (2) map ConvexBody → MeasurableSet with volume, (3) apply Mathlib Minkowski, (4) translate result back to custom types
Estimated effort: 200+ lines of bridge code. Best done as a dedicated session.
The ℤⁿ case can bypass the custom Lattice/HasVolume types entirely — work directly with Fin n → ℝ and actual Lebesgue measure
Module.finrank_fin_fun gives finrank ℝ (Fin n → ℝ) = n, needed for volume threshold
General lattice elimination requires constructing Module.Basis from the custom Lattice.basis matrix — Mathlib has Matrix.toLin for this
The HasVolume typeclass is the fundamental barrier: it is an abstract ℝ not connected to actual Lebesgue measure
General Minkowski from Mathlib only needs Module.Basis + ZSpan.isAddFundamentalDomain + ZSpan.volume_fundamentalDomain — 3-line proof
The gap is now purely type-bridging: connecting custom Lattice.basis matrix to Module.Basis. Requires Matrix.toLin to build LinearEquiv from invertible matrix.
nextSteps: REFACTORING needed: Replace HasVolume with measure-theoretic version (add carrier_measurable + volume_eq fields)
Bridge Lattice.basis matrix → Module.Basis via Basis.map + LinearEquiv from invertible matrix
Docker required for build verification of any changes
Alternative: replace entire custom type architecture with Mathlib types
